entities.name: Armand Gaston Maximilien de Rohan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Armand de Rohan was a French churchman and politician. He became Bishop of Strasbourg in 1704, Cardinal in 1712 then Grand Almoner of France in 1713 and member of the regency council in 1722.
